item.title: No suburb is immune’: BCC issues urgent flood warning
item.description: As heavy rains continue to lash parts of the country, the Bulawayo City Council (BCC) has issued a strong public warning urging residents to take flooding seriously, stressing that no suburb is immune, whether high-density, low-density, peri-urban or industrial.

item.title: ZAPU admits internal turmoil as leadership wrangles expose wider opposition fragility
item.description: ZAPU president Sibangilizwe Nkomo has acknowledged deepening turmoil within the opposition party he leads, warning of what he described as “negative and concerted efforts” from within its own ranks to undermine the party’s growth and stability.

item.title: As rural property booms, experts warn of ownership risks
item.description: A quiet property boom is taking shape across rural Zimbabwe, with houses rising, plots changing hands and informal rental markets emerging in areas once considered unsuitable for real estate development.

item.title: Zimbabwe faces heightened floods risk
item.description: The Famine Early Warning Systems Network (Fews Net) has issued a warning that recent heavy rains and saturated ground could lead to dangerous water accumulation and flooding, with torrential downpours forecast across the region next week.
